products.name: Credo AI
products.note: Purpose-built AI governance; policy packs for EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF; clean interface; fast deployment

profile_text.body:
Credo AI is an enterprise software company focused on AI governance, offering a platform it describes as purpose-built to help organizations discover AI systems, enforce policies, manage risk, and demonstrate compliance across models, agents, and applications. The company describes itself as having created the AI governance category and says its platform is powered by a Knowledge Graph that combines regulatory intelligence with customer business context, supported by more than 300 integrations and a team of forward-deployed governance experts. It claims its platform compresses weeks of governance work into hours through GAIA, its Govern AI Assistant, which is generally available within the product.

The core Credo AI platform covers model-level, application-level, and agent-level governance in a single product, with pre-built policy packs addressing frameworks including the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001. The company states its policy and standards work has been developed by team members involved with ISO, NIST, the EU Parliament, NATO, and the OECD. Named customers referencing the platform include Mastercard and IBM, with IBM described as collaborating on Compliance Accelerators. One unnamed customer quotes an acceleration of EU AI Act compliance at least ten times faster than manual approaches.

Credo AI is ranked No. 6 in Applied AI on Fast Company's World's Most Innovative Companies of 2026 list, alongside Google, Nvidia, OpenAI, and Anthropic, according to the company's site. The held facts confirm the company maintains a tracked product under the AI Governance and Risk Management Platforms category. No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the available data.
